Huge news today. Thank you to @RussVought47 for rolling back the Biden Administration’s disastrous CFPB 1071 rule.

I fought for years against the Biden Administration’s 1071 rule, including through my PROTECTED Act, because it was far-reaching, imposed significant costs, and unfairly hurt our smallest community banks that serve rural and underserved communities. This new rule ensures small lenders can continue to meet the needs of Main Street businesses, and I’m proud to be a strong supporter.

Grateful to @HawleyMO for his leadership on the GUARD Act, legislation to put critical safeguards in place for AI chatbots for minors. I’m proud we took this important step forward today in advancing this commonsense legislation to protect America’s youth. Let’s get it signed into law.

Video

Proud to see @UofAlabama leading the way with Alabama’s first School of Data Science.

As technology continues to rapidly evolve, it’s abundantly clear that we need to prepare the next generation of students for the future of AI, research, and innovation.
